settings.headline: Confidence starts with comfort.
settings.subhead: A topical preparation made for aesthetic appointments. Three strengths and three formats, formulated in the UK for the way modern sessions actually run.
settings.image_alt: Senseless topical preparation range arranged on a warm off-white background with a purple brand accent
settings.caption: The Senseless range — formulated in the UK.

settings.headline: Match the formula to your appointment.
settings.lead: Aesthetic appointments vary. The product you bring to them should reflect that. Clinical for routine sessions. Advanced for longer or more sensitive work. Professional, our most concentrated formula, formulated for clinicians and available to all.

settings.label: Clinical Strength
settings.heading: For routine appointments
settings.body: The everyday Senseless. Used for top-ups, routine microneedling, smaller laser zones, and the appointments most clients book most often. Quietly capable.
settings.image_alt: Clinical Strength Senseless cream on a warm off-white background

settings.label: Advanced Strength
settings.heading: For longer or more demanding sessions
settings.body: The considered upgrade. Higher concentration, formulated for longer sessions and more sensitive indications. Chosen by clients who know what their appointment will ask of them.
settings.image_alt: Advanced Strength Senseless cream on a warm off-white background

settings.label: Professional Strength
settings.heading: Our most concentrated formula
settings.body: Developed with practitioners. Used in clinics across the UK. Available without restriction. Professional sits at the top of the Senseless system. Trusted at the chair.
settings.image_alt: Professional Strength Senseless cream on a warm off-white background

settings.headline: Two quick decisions: strength, then format.
settings.body: Match the strength to your appointment, then choose the format for the treatment area.

settings.label: Numbing Cream
settings.body: The everyday format, in three strengths and two sizes.

settings.label: Numbing Spray
settings.body: For body areas and procedures across larger zones.

settings.headline: Cream, Gel, and Spray.
settings.body: Cream covers most appointments. Gel and Spray each have their place — and many clients keep more than one.

settings.quote: Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not pharmacy. A topical preparation developed for the way modern aesthetic appointments actually work: short windows between booking and the chair, sensitive treatment areas, and clients who care about the experience as much as the result.

settings.headline: Stay close.
settings.body: Notes from the Senseless team. New product launches, prep guidance for upcoming sessions, and what we're hearing from the clinics that stock us.
